title: Evaluation equation for open quotient scalar compatibility
statement:
For an integral open operation o, a finite comparison family and a strict-system comparison as above satisfy
the coefficient-evaluation equation defining ScalarCompatibility.evaluation.

source.place: Tags 0E8I and 0941; normalized generator equation after coefficient evaluation.

proof.text:
Evaluate the strict-system identity on a complex, a coefficient level and a cochain degree. On each
extension-by-zero generator, both sides are the same unit insertion. The finite scalar comparison and
system comparison are natural, so generator extensionality and sheafification give the equality for all
sections.

lean.statement:
theorem openQuotientScalarEvaluationCompatibility
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (finite : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙ scalarReductionRestriction l E X n ≅
        scalarReductionRestriction l E U n ⋙ IntegralOpenReduction.extension l E j o)
    (systems : (IntegralOpenReduction.systemExtension l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        forgetSystems l E X ≅ forgetSystems l E U ⋙ extendTower l E j o) :
    ∀ (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E U) ℤ)
      (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      HEq (((systems.hom.app C).app (op n)).f i)
        ((finite n).hom.app ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E U n).obj (C.X i)))
